UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the AgoraCare application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatar.description: The avatar id of the user.

role.description: The role of the user in the family.

Medication.title: Medication
Medication.description: Represents a medication prescribed to a user.

schedule.description: How often the medication should be taken (e.g., once daily).

date.description: The date and time of the appointment.

doctor.description: The name of the doctor for the appointment.

EmergencyContact.title: EmergencyContact
EmergencyContact.description: Represents an emergency contact for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the emergency contact.

name.description: The name of the emergency contact.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the emergency contact.

relation.description: The relationship of the contact to the user (e.g., son, daughter).

Prescription.title: Prescription
Prescription.description: Represents a prescription issued to a user.

medicationName.description: The name of the prescribed medication.

dosage.description: The prescribed dosage of the medication.

frequency.description: How often the medication should be taken.

doctorName.description: The name of the doctor who issued the prescription.

issueDate.description: The date the prescription was issued.

VitalSign.title: VitalSign
VitalSign.description: Represents a user's vital signs at a specific time.

date.description: The date of the vital sign reading.

heartRate.description: The user's heart rate in beats per minute.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support AgoraCare's core features while adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling. User profiles are stored under `/users/{userId}` to ensure path-based ownership and private data access. The caregiver relationships are managed through a separate collection `/users/{userId}/caregivers` to ensure authorization independence. This enables direct access control for caregivers. Medications, Appointments, Emergency Contacts, Prescriptions, and Vitals are modeled as subcollections of `/users/{userId}`, enabling straightforward path-based ownership. This structure allows for secure list operations (QAPs) since each subcollection is homogeneous in its security posture. The use of path-based ownership simplifies security rules, focusing on `request.auth.uid` without relying on complex `get()` calls. This achieves Authorization Independence, simplifies debugging, and maintains data integrity.
